nagoya_pivote.price_note: Prices are from the shop's own printed board mounted outside the door, photographed 2020/05 and still in place when re-shot 2022/11 — the newest legible copy there is. Tabelog's current bands (dinner ¥10,000–¥14,999, lunch ¥6,000–¥7,999) still bracket them, so they are probably close but not guaranteed. An earlier 2019/01 board carried a cheaper ¥2,500–¥5,400 lunch range that has been struck through and replaced. This is a teppan counter with no à-la-carte list — course names and prices are all it publishes. Prices approximate — may change.
